messages:
maya: heads up - p95 on /v1/generate spiking in dashboard but not on endpoint breakdown, anyone see this?
liam: I see. which dashboard? the endpoint-split or the global route?
alex: do we have sampling on for endpoint split? might be using route-tagged sampled data.
maya: endpoint split. overall p95 shows normal ~120ms, split shows /v1/generate p95 ~420ms
sam: small n=heavy variance, yeah. Could be a fencepost problem with tdigest merge when counts small
katie: can you paste the query payload? maybe we're filtering client tags unintentionally
maya: here is the filter: { "route": "/v1/generate", "merge_mode": "by_route", "lookback": "1h" }
liam: looks ok. Dev note: when merge_mode=by_route we force per-route tdigest then rollup, small-route tdigest compression=100 may blow up percentiles
alex: maybe the UI smoothing hides tiny-n spikes. We should show sample_count badge next to p50/p95 in compact view
maya: agree. For short term, can we fallback to global rollup if sample_count < 50?
sam: quick patch: if count < 50 then show "unstable" + tooltip linking to raw histogram. Also add route tag origin: "sample_source" in tooltip.
katie: UX: add subtle warning icon :warning: and tooltip "low sample count — percentile unstable"
deploy-bot: deploy queued by liam for branch pctl-fallback (ci/142) — ETA ~10m
alex: also raising a potential API debate: should backend expose "percentile_confidence" in telemetry API (float 0-1) so Console can decide?
maya: yes. backend knows count and distribution, easy to expose. would help product decisions.
liam: ok i'll add telemetry field pct_confidence and bump schema v2 — rolling change, will be backward compatible
maya: thanks. follow-ups: add unit test for tdigest merge with small counts, and file a console issue for the warning UI.
sam: filing issues: ENG-4812 (tdigest small-count test), DEVEX-337 (console low-sample badge)
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
katie: tagging @product-sara so visibility for UX change
product-sara: noted. prefer "insight" language vs "unstable" in tooltip.
